inputs.xrk: native XRK via env FUJI_WET_XRK / FUJI_DRY_XRK (local only; channel dump in I2_WORK)

l2Sector.definition: dLat = variant minus shipped lateral position (track normal, + = right of travel) in the sector; gpsResidualLat = native GPS (+offset) minus the fused smoothed path at the fixes; steer/accy lag: s maximising corr(path a_lat(t), channel(t+s)) (sign-corrected, +-1 s; + = channel later = GPS path leads); NOT independent for fused paths (their course rate comes from the gyro, which shares the logger clock with steer and the accelerometer)
